description: No sign, no window, no name over the door. A steel fire door set in brick and painted the same brown as the brick, a bare bulb in a cage above it, and a bootprint at chest height where somebody once made a point. The only advertising is what comes up through the pavement grille: beer, damp, and something older underneath both. The door is north; Kessler Street runs south.
name: Sump
